name: The Ashen Order
description: Keepers of the Greywater barrows for three hundred years, now dwindled to almost nothing.

name: The Hollow Choir
description: A subterranean conclave of grieving mortals and ancient spirits who view final death as an atrocity, binding fading souls to music boxes and reliquaries so nothing is ever lost.

name: The Wayfarers of the Threshold
description: A sanctuary movement in Nocturne who witness the grief of the waking dead, sheltering conscious spirits while guiding calcifying souls toward peaceful release.
